paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Yosef, in Rav Pappa's time, “died young.” I do not know where this statement that he died young was found, for it was Rami bar Chama who died young; see there. He reported in R. Oshaya’s name—Niddah 19a; Avodah Zarah 44b. Rashi explains: R. Oshaya was his teacher. Sanhedrin 16a, 112a has bar Yosi. When Rav Dimi came, he spoke in his name: Avodah Zarah 14b. R. Chiyya—the Babylonian Talmud has bar Abba—and R. Yasa and R. Imma questioned him at Chammat of Gerar, etc.; “R. Yochanan said, etc.” and “Resh Lakish, etc.”: Jerusalem Eruvin, HaDar. But the Babylonian Talmud there, 65b, says they asked R. Chiyya bar Yosef.
